data.name: Karishma
data.gender_notes: Karishma is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Sanskrit ‘Kaara’ (Desire) and ‘Shma’ (Love), Karishma is a name evoking the goddess of love and desire, Parvati. It carries the essence of the divine feminine and embodies the power of attraction and passion. The name Karishma carries the meaning “Goddess of Love and Desire” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Karishma usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of love and desire and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Manifestation of divine love and desire.
data.etymology: Karishma belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Love and Desire.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Karishma total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

It is believed that the name holds the power to captivate hearts and awaken passion, as it is connected to Parvati, the goddess of love and desire. The name has been passed down through generations, and it continues to be popular among Hindus as a meaningful and evocative name for their children.

It serves as a constant reminder of the importance of living a life filled with love, passion, and self-awareness, as inspired by Parvati herself. vedic_reference.note: Derived from the Sanskrit root 'kar' meaning 'to do' or 'to create'

historical_references.reference: The name Karishma is derived from the Sanskrit word Karishma, which means the 'act of doing'. This name was believed to bring good fortune and success to the person bearing it. It is mentioned in various Hindu scriptures including the Mahabharata and the Ramayana.

The Hindu goddess Karishma is also known as the goddess of knowledge and wisdom. She is depicted as having four arms, each holding a symbol of knowledge - a book, a rosary, a vessel of knowledge (Gyan Kalash), and a bell. She is believed to be the wife of the god of learning, Lord Ganesha.

modern_usage.modern_context: Karishma is a modern name of Indian origin, gaining popularity in various fields. In the acting industry, she is recognized for her work in Bollywood films. As a model, she is often seen on fashion magazine covers and runways. In the digital space, she is an influencer, using her social media presence on Instagram and YouTube to reach millions of followers with her content.
